description: Display a simple 3-layer feed-forward neural network [3, 5, 2] as a static diagram using NeuralNetwork and FeedForwardLayer.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import NeuralNetwork, FeedForwardLayer

class FFNBasic(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        nn = NeuralNetwork([
            FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=3),
            FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=5),
            FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=2),
        ])
        nn.move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.add(nn)
        self.wait(0.5)
